Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this match. Do join us on 17th March for the second ODI at 0930 local, 0400 GMT. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Asghar Stanikzai says that his players played really well and credits Dawlat Zadran and Rashid Khan for bringing them back in the game. Informs that he wanted Rashid and Dawlat to bowl with the old balls as both of them are quite good with it.

In spite of ending on the losing side, William Porterfield is awarded the Man of the Match for his superb century. He says that they should have won the match. Adds that his partnership with Stirling was important but he knew it's not easy to bat for the new batsman. Admits that not having any other partnership cost them the game.

Ireland will be heartbroken after this loss. They held the game by the scruff of the neck but then allowed it to slip away from their grasp. The middle order wasted the start and capitulated. Afghanistan should be given a lot of credit for triggering a collapse as at one stage Ireland were cruising on 206/2. Plenty of soul-searching to do for the Irish team.

Excellent win for Afghanistan. They were under the pump at one stage when the big partnership between Paul Stirling and William Porterfield was prospering. But once again it was Rashid Khan who brought them back in the game by providing the breakthrough. He was too hot to handle and finished with a 4-fer. Dawlat Zadran also bowled an exemplary spell with the old ball and grabbed a 4-wicket haul which included the prized scalp of William Porterfield.

OUT! AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 30 RUNS! Zadran digs in a short ball around off after seeing the charge from the batsman, Chase still attempts to wheel a pull shot but it takes the top edge and goes straight down the throat of the long on fielder, Shafiqullah Shafiq (sub). That's all, Afghanistan take a 1-0 lead in the 5-match series.
That missed everything! Clever slower delivery, full and angling into the batsman, Chase is early into the swing of his bat and misses. It goes closely past the leg stump to the keeper.
Eyes the blockhole, Mulder brings his bat down just in time and it goes off the inside edge to fine leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Very full and around off, swinging in the air, Chase hits it down to long on for a single.
Shortish and outside off, bunted towards mid off for a run.
Dawlat Zadran replaces Rashid Khan in the attack.
Fullish and on middle, it's pushed to covers for a quick single.
Full and angling into the batsman, Chase tries to swing across the line but ends up slicing it in the air over covers. It falls safely in the deep and they take a run.
Good length delivery outside off, forced through covers for one.
EDGY FOUR! Naib angles in a length ball around off, Mulder makes room to play it through covers but it catches the outside edge flies wide of the keeper for a boundary at third man.
Back of a length ball on off, Chase turns it off his pads to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, straightening a touch, Chase decides not to chase it.
Gulbadin Naib is back on. 42 needed off 30 balls.
Leans forward and pushes a full ball to point.
Flatter leg spinner on middle and off, Chase defends it off the back foot to the leg side and crosses for a run.
FOUR! Fires a quicker one on the leg stump line, Chase works it off his pads and it runs past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Peter Chase is the last batsman.

OUT! Plumb in front! Rashid Khan is just toying around with his variations. Dishes out a googly, landing around off on a fuller length and spinning in, Dockrell fails to pick it, stays back to defend but before his bat can come down, the ball has rapped him on the pads. The finger goes up immediately once the appeal was made.
Loopy ball around off, Dockrell pushes inside the line and misses.
FOUR! Fantastic hit! A flatter and shorter leg spinner around off, Dockrell goes deep inside the crease and pulls it against the spin over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Fine shot! Full floated ball on off, Mulder skips down the track and drills it past the diving extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Short and pulled on the leg side, in the gap at mid-wicket and a run is taken.
Flatter and shorter on off, Dockrell gets down the track and punches it through covers for one.
Advances down the track and helps it through mid-wicket for another single.
Slower through the air, full and around off, it's clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.
Turning back into the new batsman from outside off, Mulder works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Jacob Mulder is the new batsman. A slip in place.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! A leg spinner landing around middle and leg, turning in, Murtagh fails to pick it, probably was expecting a googly but it turns back in to strike him on the back pad. They appeal and the finger goes up. 60 needed off 43 balls.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Short and outside off, cut through point for one.
Excellent googly, landing around leg and spinning the other way, Tim pushes inside the line and misses.
Fires a fuller ball on off, Murtagh defends it off his front foot.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tim Murtagh is the new batsman.

OUT! Bowled or stumped? Not quite sure. Hamza fires another full ball on off, turning away just a shade, Kevin gets forward to push at it but in the process moves outside the crease. Shahzad collects the ball and removes the bails immediately. And then just to be sure, he takes the leg stump out as well. There is a confusion whether the ball hit the stumps before going into the keeper's gloves. Anyway, O'Brien has to depart and Ireland are staring down the barrel.
Quicker and flatter arm ball on middle, punched through covers for a run.
Full floated ball on middle, knocked down to wide long on for a run.
Fires in a shorter ball on off, it's cut straight to point.
Flatter and on middle, punched back and the bowler moved across to his right to stop the ball.

Direct hit would have been run out! Flatter fuller ball on off, Kevin drives it to extra cover and crosses for a non-existent single. The fielder misses his shy at the non-striker's end and grants a life to O'Brien.
Flatter and shorter again, on off, cut through point for a run.
Googly landing outside off and spinning back in from a shorter length, O'Brien punches it to covers and crosses for a brisk single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Dockrell chops his cut shot to short third man.
Lovely leg spinner on off, George plays for the spin and gets beaten.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler who parried it towards covers. A single taken.

Not out! Bowls it slower through the air, Dockrell looks to drive but gets beaten on the turn. Shahzad gathers the ball and dislodges the bails. Afghanistan appeal and the umpire has taken it upstairs. Replays suggest that Dockrell was well inside his crease.
Appeal for a stumping, referred upstairs...
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loops this one around middle, Kevin uses his feet and drives it to long on. Single taken.
Kevin dances down the track and flicks this floated delivery to mid-wicket.
Tosses this one around off, Kevin goes back and cuts it to the cover fielder.
Bowls a full delivery around off, Kevin taps it towards point.
Bowls a yorker length delivery on middle, Dockrell jams it out towards the leg side for one run.
George Dockrell is the new man in.

OUT! Ireland have lost half their side. The hosts are ecstatic. Full delivery, coming back in, Thompson looks to go over mid off. But the substitute fielder, Shafiqullah Shafaq, takes a good running catch to his left. Ireland need 73 runs off 67 balls.
Lands this on a length and manages to bring it back in again, Kevin flicks it towards the leg side. Single taken.
On a length around leg, Stuart has tucked it away to fine leg. One run added to the total.
Full delivery and swinging away, Thompson looks to straight drive but it goes off the leading edge to point.
Angles a length ball on the pads, Thompson looks to flick but fails to put bat to ball. A stifled appeal from the bowler is turned down.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. Ireland need 75 runs off 72 balls.
Thompson uses his feet and drives this fullish delivery through mid-on for a single.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Floats this on around middle, flicked away to mid-wicket.
Tosses this one around middle and leg, Kevin eases it down to long on for one run.
Bowls this a lot straighter and on the sticks, Kevin knocks it back to the bowler.
Wide! Down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
Stuart Thompson is the new batsman.

OUT! Three wickets in the last two overs and suddenly the complexion of the game has changed. Pitches this on a length around off, Wilson looks to tuck it away as the ball comes back in. Interestingly Zadran has managed to extract reverse swing which has got him this wicket. Wilson goes for a duck!
Wide! Tries to bowl an inswinging yorker but bowls it down the leg side. He will have to bowl that one again.
Gary Wilson is the new batsman.

OUT! The captain has to depart. Slowly, but surely, the hosts are coming back into the game. Fuller delivery around off, WP looks to chip it over covers but doesn't quite time his shot. It lobs towards covers, where the fielder ran across to take a sharp catch. Ireland need 79 runs off 79 balls.
Fullish delivery in the line of fourth stump, WP drills it through covers for  a couple.
On a length outside off, Kevin drives it wide mid off for a single
Huge LBW appeal, but turned down! Length delivery, which comes back in, Kevin looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire didn't give it because it was going down the leg side.
Angles in a full delivery, which nips back in, Kevin defends it from the crease.
Bowls this a lot faster and around off, Porterfield looks to nudge it away but fails to get to the ball.
A short delivery which has been pulled away.
Kevin pushes this floated delivery towards covers for one run.
FOUR! Gets off the mark in style though with some luck. Tossed up around off, Kevin looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge and runs away for a boundary towards third man.
Kevin O'Brien replaces his brother in the middle.

OUT! The southpaw was struggling and Rashid has sent him back to the hut. How many times has he brought his side back into the game? He probably played for the googly but the ball turned the other side. Pitching on off, Niall looks to drive but gets beaten by the turn and gets rapped on the pads. Rashid appeals and the umpires has given Niall O'Brien the marching orders. IRELAND NEED 87 RUNS IN 88 BALLS!
Short and spinning in, William pulls it to deep mid-wicket. One run taken!
Rashid Khan is back into the attack.

FOUR! On a length outside off, Niall opens his arms and cuts it.  Naib, from sweeper cover, hares across but while stopping the ball he remains in contact with the ropes. So the umpire has signaled it as a boundary after confirmation from upstairs.
Wide! Shortish delivery, down the leg side, Niall looks to pull but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Niall looks to cut this length ball but fails to put bat on ball.
Back of a length delivery, around leg, WP pulls it uppishly towards fine leg. Rashid Khan, in deep, runs across and makes a fine stop. Single taken.

FOUR! Unlucky Afghanistan! William looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes past diving first slip for a boundary. The captain had deployed a slip for that exact shot, but the ball evaded the fielder.
Length ball and outside off, Niall strides forward and drives it firmly through covers for a run.
Fuller delivery outside off, Porterfield opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
Dawlat Zadran is back on.
Straighter delivery and on middle, Niall goes forward and blocks it. Four consecutive dot balls to end a tidy over.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Bowls this a lot flatter and outside off, Niall cuts it very late to the cover fielder.
Loops this one around off, Niall drives it towards covers.
Tosses this outside off, WP sweeps it in front of square for one run.
Sprays this around leg, Porterfield sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Porterfield clips this fullish delivery to deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Niall strides forward and clips it towards mid-wicket. One run taken.
WP flicks this floated delivery through mid-wicket for an easy single.
FOUR! Marvelous shot this from the southpaw. Loops this one around leg, Porterfield kneels and sweeps it extremely fine. The deep fielder chased it only to come second.
O'Brien uses his feet and looks to flick this tossed up delivery but it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg. One run taken!
Tossed up around middle and leg, WP reverse sweeps it to point and steals a quick single.
Amir Hamza comes back into the attack.
Time for drinks. Ireland are in control of the match. They need 110 runs off 108 balls with eight wickets remaining.
Leans forward and pushes a full ball with the spin to point. Dot ball to end the over.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
William Porterfield brings up his 9th ODI hundred!

Hundred for Porterfield! A very responsible knock by the Irish skipper. Flatter and shorter on off, William gets back and punches it past the diving cover fielder for a couple of runs. Ireland need their skipper to bat through to see them home.
Very full ball on off, driven through covers for a single.
Slow loopy full ball on middle, Niall lunges and defends it back.
Flatter and shorter on off, forced down to long off for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bends his back knee and turns it with the spin through mid on for a run. The bowler chases it and keeps them down to one.
Loopy and wide outside off, William flashes and misses.
FOUR! Shot! Floated full ball wide outside off, Porterfield gets forward with a big stretch and swats it through covers for a cracking boundary.
Tries flicking it on the leg side but fails to connect. It goes off his pads to square leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Beauty of a delivery. A googly landing around off, Niall fails to pick it, goes back to defend but is beaten.
Strides forward and plays it with soft hands to covers for a brisk single.
Tossed up outside off, driven off the front foot, with the spin but it has gone straight to the cover fielder.
Loopy and on off, defended off the front foot again.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Fires in a full ball on off, it's defended off the front foot to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mohammad Nabi is back into the attack for another spell. With two left-handers in the middle, he can be a handy option. A slip in place.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. No run to end a successful over.
Spinning down, worked towards short fine leg for one.
Niall O'Brien has arrived at the crease.

OUT! And Rashid Khan provides the breakthrough! Excellent return catch by the leggie. Floated full ball on middle, served from back of the hand, Stirling once again ends up pushing it off the leading part of the bat and Rashid reacts quickly to grab the catch. End of a big 157-run stand. 123 needed off 128 balls!
Loopy leg spinner on off, Stirling tries playing across the line but gets it away off the splice of the bat to covers.
Drags his length short and lands it on middle, Porterfield gets back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter leg spinner outside off, William allows it through to the keeper.
Rashid Khan is back into the attack. Afghanistan need a breakthrough immediately. Can he provide it?
Fires a full ball on the pads, it's flicked straight to short mid-wicket. Gets away with a bad ball, Naib.
Goes back and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for one.
FOUR! Naib bowls a cutter around leg, it's a bit on the shorter side and Porterfield cheekily glances it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for one.
Good length ball on off, Porterfield punches it off his back foot to mid off. Another quick single pinched. 150-run stand comes up!
Full around leg, Paul plays it off his pads to wide mid on where the fielder dives to make a half stop. A single is taken.

FOUR! Poor delivery! Fine leg is up inside the ring and Shenwari fires a full ball down the leg side, Porterfield goes down on one knee and sweeps it wide of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Fuller this time, around leg, William fails to flick and it goes off his pads to mid-wicket.
Drops it short on off, Stirling pulls this time, to deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Short again and it's pulled by William to long leg for one.
FOUR! That went like a tracer bullet! Shenwari bowls a loopy half-tracker around leg, Porterfield turns inside the crease and hammer-pulls it to the deep square leg fence.
Loopy leg spinner outside off, a touch on the shorter side and not spinning much, Stirling slaps it to sweeper cover for a run.
Samiullah Shenwari is introduced into the attack.
Digs in a short ball on off, Paul gets on top of the bounce and just turns it through square leg for a run. Didn't try to hit it hard, just rolled his wrists over it.
Shortish and around off, Porterfield swings it straight to long leg and crosses for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Quality shot! Back of a length ball on off, Stirling rocks back and punches it sweetly past the left side of the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Runs in from around the wicket and angles in a slower shortish length ball on off, Porterfield stays back and dabs it to third man for a run.
Gulbadin Naib comes back into the attack.
WP reverse sweeps this tossed up delivery to short third man and runs one.
Stirling dances down to the pitch of the delivery and drives it wide mid on for a single.

No it isn't! Stirling survives. Hamza draws the batsman ahead for a front foot defense and beats him on the turn. Shahzad gathers the ball and whips the bails off. The keeper thinks he's got his man and appeals. The umpire take it upstairs. Replays show that, though the back leg was in the air for a while, the batsman did well put it in just in time. The struggle to break this partnership continues.
The umpires have referred for a stumping against Paul Stirling upstairs. The hosts are confident. Is that the breakthrough delivery?
Drags his length back, on leg, tucked away to square leg for one run.
Tossed up outside off, Porterfield drives it to mid off.
Uses his feet to this straighter delivery and knocks it down the ground for one run.
Amir Hamza comes back into the attack.
WP buries this fullish delivery onto the pitch.
Stirling drives this looped up delivery through mid on for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Stirling goes ahead and pats this tossed up delivery towards point for one run.
FOUR! This partnership keeps getting better. Bowls it slower through the air and on middle. Stirling gets across and sweeps it past the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Floats this one around off, Stirling goes forward and dead-bats it.
Loops this one outside off, William drives it uppishly towards covers.
WP lunges and knocks this tossed up delivery straight to the bowler.
Stirling taps this fullish delivery to point for one run.
Tossed up outside off, WP strides forward and drives it to long off for one run.
WP goes back and tucks away this shortish delivery.
Tossed up around off, Stirling leans forward and defends it off the outside half of his willow through covers. One run taken.
WP pushes this fullish delivery to the point region.
Stirling reverse sweeps this floated delivery which was pitched outside off towards point. One run taken!
Flighted delivery outside off, Stirling pushes it to covers.
Stirling uses his feet and dead-bats it.
Tosses this one around leg, WP flicks it through mid-wicket. Single taken.
FOUR! Full and around middle, WP kneels and sweeps it very fine. The deep square leg fielder had no chance to cut it off.
Bowls this a lot fuller and outside off, carved to deep point for one run.
Loops this one around off, Stirling knocks it through mid on for a run.
WP drives this tossed up delivery to long off for a single.
Flatter and on the leg stump, WP goes back and defends.
William looks to flick this tossed up delivery, but misses the ball and gets rapped on the pads. Rashid appeals, but it was going down the leg side.
Tosses this one outside off, Stirling drives it through covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drives this slower delivery straight to covers.
Loops this one outside off, drilled through covers for one run.
WP flicks this tossed up delivery, which stays low, through mid-wicket. One run added to the total!
Tossed up around off, Stirling pushes it towards the off side and runs one.
Bowls this one a lot flatter and on off, Stirling goes forward to block.
Mohammad Nabi comes back into the attack.
Tosses this one outside off, WP leaves it alone.
Googly! Stirling read it early and stayed in his crease. Rocks back and cuts it through covers for one run.
Tosses this on around middle and leg, Stirling flicks to mid-wicket.
Porterfield goes back and works this shortish delivery towards mid-wicket for a run.
Wide! Really sloppy start for Rashid. Bowls this down the leg side again. He will have to bowl that one again.
FOUR! Bowls it slower through the air and on the pads, WP this sweeps it hard. The deep fielder hared across but failed to stop it.
FOUR! Starts with a poor delivery, bowls it down the leg side, Porterfield tickles it fine and it beats the short fine leg fielder easily.
Rashid Khan finally comes into the attack.
Sharp running! Full delivery, which comes back in, WP knocks it to mid off and sets off for a run. The mid off fielder throws at the non-striker's end but William had made his ground.
Length ball outside off, WP drives it down to mid off.
Bowls this a touch straighter and on off, Stirling taps it to third man. One run added to the total!
Slower delivery on middle, Stirling cuts it to the cover point fielder.
Angles in a length ball on middle, tucked away to square leg for one run.
Length ball outside off, cut to point for a single.
14th ODI fifty for William Porterfield.

FOUR! Fifty up for Porterfield. Full and outside off, WP unleashes the reverse sweep once again and gets the same result as he got off the first ball of the over. Also brings up the 100-run mark for Ireland.
Stirling dances down the track and flicks this floated delivery through long on for a single.
Tosses this one outside off, Stirling defends it towards covers.
Stirling looks to flick this floated delivery but it takes the leading edge and lobs towards the bowler. However it falls short of him.
WP pushes this tossed up delivery through covers for one run.
FOUR! Reverse sweep, brilliant shot! Bowls a full delivery outside off, WP gets into the position early and hits it past the point fielder. Glorious shot, it will put Hamza under pressure.
Amir Hamza is back into the attack.
Length ball, on off, Stirling offers a front foot defense.
Angles a full ball on the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for a run.
Length ball, which nips back in, WP drives it towards the cover point fielder.
Good length delivery around off, Porterfield steers it straight to point.
Back of a length delivery, on the sticks, William defends it from the crease.
Length ball around off, WP pushes it towards the off side.
Drinks have been taken.
Too full in length around off, Stirling tries to play straight but the bat turns in his hands and he ends up pushing it off the inside edge to mid on.
On a length around off, dabbed to point.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! Length ball landing on off and angling in, Stirling fails to defend it off his front foot and is hit on the pads. They appeal but it's too high.
Angles a full ball down the leg side, Stirling plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Full again, around off, Paul plays close to his body and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
FOUR! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Stirling latches onto the room and drives it square of the wicket past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Fuller and angling in from around off, Porterfield drills it through the line but finds mid off.
Wide! Bowls it full and outside off, Porterfield backs away to make space and ends up reaching and missing. Shahzad is not happy with the call. Free Hit stays...
Another Free Hit for Ireland......
No ball called for overstepping. Fuller and on off, driven back.
Too full in length and on off, Porterfield plays straight but finds the mid on fielder.
Lands it full again, outside off, it's driven off the front foot through point for a run.
Full and straight, played off the pads to mid-wicket.
Returns to over the wicket for the right-hander and serves a short ball outside off, Stirling tries to pull it over mid-wicket but fails to connect.
Runs in from around the wicket and spears in a fuller length ball on off, William wrists it to long leg for a run.
Change of ends for Gulbadin Naib.
Half-tracker and around leg, Porterfield turns and pulls it through backward square leg for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Stirling throws his bat at it and places his shot through cover-point for a run.
Full and angling into the batsman, around off, Paul defends it with a straight bat.
Good length ball angling in around off, Stirling stays back and pushes it towards point.
Bowled! But it's a Free Hit. Zadran bowls it full and straight, a full toss in fact, Stirling swings early and misses to find his stumps disturbed.
Free Hit coming up...
Angles in a full ball on middle, Paul defends it watchfully. No ball called for overstepping.
Fullish and on middle, Porterfield gets on the front foot and drives it a bit uppishly through extra cover. The mid off fielder moves across to his right to stop the ball and they complete a single.
Dawlat Zadran comes back into the attack.
Slow loopy ball on middle, Stirling gets forward and defends it with a straight bat.
Full and fired outside off, Porterfield wanted to play it through the line but it came off the inside half of the bat and went to long on for one.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Forces a full ball through mid on for a run.

FOUR! Floated full ball landing outside off, Porterfield plays a neatly timed reverse sweep and it beats short third man. The fielder however tries his best to pull it back after chasing but fails in his attempt.
FOUR! Hamza is on the shorter side first up in this spell, Porterfield gets back and pulls it thunderously to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Amir Hamza is back on.
50-run stand comes up between William Porterfield and Paul Stirling.
SIX! Bang! Out of here. Naib bowls a short delivery on middle, the pace is not quite there to trouble the batsman, Paul rides the bounce and hammers his pull shot over square leg for a biggie.
Shortish and outside off, William punches it to covers for one.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Porterfield turns it off his pads to mid-wicket.

Slower in pace on this occasion, full and outside off, Porterfield drives it to short cover. The fielder collects the ball and has an immediate shy at the bowler's end. Misses the stumps as Stirling plants his bat inside the crease and this time there is a fielding backing up the throw.
Shortish on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Good length delivery outside off, Stirling runs it down to third man and takes a single.
Powerplay 2 time. Maximum 4 fielders now allowed outside the circle. Gulbadin Naib will continue...
Tosses this one outside off, Stirling whips it with the turn through mid-wicket. One run taken.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Stirling uses his feet and flicks this tossed up delivery to mid-wicket.
Drags his length back a bit, William goes on his back foot and drills it through covers. One run added to the total!
Bowls it slower through the air around off, WP goes forward to defend but gets beaten on the turn.
Stirling eases this tossed up delivery to long on and runs one.

FOUR! Unnecessary from Afghanistan! William drives a full delivery towards short cover. The fielder there thinks that Stirling is out of his crease, which he wasn't, and hurls a throw at the non-striker's end. It goes past everyone to the deep mid-wicket fence. Ireland would take those overthrows all day long.
FOUR! Bangs this short and outside off, Porterfield hacks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Beautiful shot that!
On a length, comes back in, WP defends it off his back foot to the mid-wicket fielder.
Angles in a length delivery, which nips back in, William drives it to mid off.
Sprays this on the pads, Stirling flicks it to long leg for a single.
Bowls a full delivery on the sticks, Stirling moves across and is rock solid in defense.
Floats this one on leg, Stirling drives it to the long on region. Single taken!
Quicker delivery outside off, driven away through covers for one run.
Tosses this one around off, WP tucks it around to mid-wicket.
A slip comes into place for the left-hander.
Flatter delivery on middle, Stirling knocks it through mid on. One  run added to the total!
Loops this one outside off, Stirling defends it off his front foot.
Tosses this one outside off, WP rocks back and whacks it to long off. Single taken!
Mohammad Nabi comes into the attack.
Stirling looks to on drive this full ball, but it goes off the outside edge towards the off side.
FOUR! Close shave and lucky runs for Ireland. Naib bangs this short, Stirling goes for the pull but inside edges the ball. It goes past Shahzad and rolls away for a boundary.
Good length delivery which bounces a bit more, Stirling defends it from the inner half of the bat towards the leg side.
Short of a length delivery, chest height, Stirling stands firm and defends it from the crease.
Fullish delivery, around off, Stirling plays a cracking drive straight to the cover fielder.
Lands this on a length in the line of fifth stump, Stirling drives it towards covers.
Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack, replacing Hamza.
Angles in a length ball, which swings away, Porterfield pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Successive boundaries for the skipper. Full and outside off, WP lunges and drives it down the ground. The ball beats the mid off fielder easily and rolls away for a boundary.
FOUR! Loose delivery from Zadran. Length ball and on the pads, all William had to do was flick it away to the vacant square leg region. He does and gets a boundary in reward.
On a length outside, guides it down to third man for a single.
Bowls this a lot straighter and on middle, Stirling knocks it towards mid on.
Full ball, outside off, Stirling goes forward and drives it. The point fielder makes a good save, stops four runs for his team!
Lunges to drive through the line but gets a soft outside edge towards the point region. 10 runs off the over and a close call on the stumping appeal.
FOUR! And again. Hamza seems to be losing control over his length. Drops another shorter one outside off and the Irish skipper whacks it through covers to collect another boundary.
FOUR! Hamza drags his length short outside off, William immediately goes on the back foot and punches it sweetly through covers for a boundary.

Not out! Lovely delivery by Hamza, he lets out an arm ball around off, Porterfield gets forward with a big stretch and tries to play for the spin. But it skids through to beat the outside edge. Great piece of glovework by Shahzad as he immediately takes the bails off. He appeals and the square leg umpire goes upstairs. The replays show that Porterfield's back leg is on the line, there is nothing behind the crease but hang on, another angle shows there is something behind. It seems there is not enough evidence and the benefit of the doubt goes to the Irish skipper.
Appeal for stumping, referred upstairs...
Flighted full ball drifting into the batsman around off, Stirling charges down the track and eases it through mid off for a single.
Fires in a fuller ball on middle, Porterfield knocks it down to long on for a run.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it off the back foot to the off side.
Around off on a good length, Stirling defends it off his back foot.
FOUR! Following the pads again, it's eased through backward square leg and the fine leg fielder fails to cut it off after putting a big chase. Wrong line this by Zadran.

Is that dropped? Yes, it is. Length ball angling down the leg side, Stirling tries flicking but gets an inside edge behind. Shahzad dives to his left but fails to hold on to the catch. Nearly another wicket to a poor ball down to leg.
Angles a full length ball down the leg side, Stirling nudges it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Full and angling in around off, Stirling gets behind the line and pushes it to covers.
William Porterfield is the new man in.

OUT! Joyce walks! Not a wicket taking delivery by any means, it's down the leg side, Ed looks to flick but gets a faint tickle behind to the keeper. Shahzad reacts quickly to his right and snaps a sharp reflex catch. He jumps in celebration and Joyce walks without waiting for the umpire's decision. Hamza draws first blood and it's a big wicket.
Charges down the track and drives it wide of mid off for a run.
Stirling has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

That has beaten everything! Loopy full ball outside off, skidding through the angle, Stirling plays for the spin and gets beaten. It beats the inside edge and goes behind. Luckily for Paul it didn't hit the stumps.
Walks down the track and pushes it off his pads towards mid on for a run.
Shortish and around off, Joyce goes deep inside the crease and plays the cut shot. He however fails to beat the point fielder.
Serves it on a length and in the line of the off stump, Paul shows respect this time and defends it by getting right behind the line.
Short again, around middle this time, Stirling opens up in his stance and mistimes his pull through mid-wicket. A couple of runs taken.
Free Hit coming up...
FOUR! Poor delivery, bowls it short and wide outside off and that's not all, he has overstepped too. Stirling latches onto it and whacks it through covers for a boundary.
Lands it full and around off, Paul lunges and defends it back to the bowler.
Angles in a full ball on middle and leg, Stirling tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Fullish and wide outside off, Ed slashes at it and hits it square of the wicket on the off side. The point fielder dives to his left and parries it behind cover-point. A single is taken.
Full in length and around off, Joyce gets on the front foot and defends it watchfully to the off side.
Dawlat Zadran to take the second new ball from the other end. He has a slip in place.
Floated full ball on off, Stirling gets forward and pushes it straight to the cover fielder. Decent first over by Hamza!
Once again Hamza serves a full ball on the leg stump line, Joyce uses his wrists to flick it through backward square leg for one.
Fires one on the pads, Joyce works it across but it has gone straight to the short fine leg fielder.
A touch flatter this time, around off and skidding in, Paul goes back and punches it to long off for a single.
Slow loopy full ball on off, Stirling stays back and defends it to the off side.

Flighted full ball outside off, Joyce gets on the front foot and softly pushes it square of the wicket on the off side. The backward point fielder moves across to his left to stop the ball and they cross for a run. Ireland are away!
Welcome back for the run chase. The players are back on the field. Ed Joyce and Paul Stirling are the openers for Ireland. Amir Hamza to begin proceedings. A slip in place. Here we go...
